definitions.explanation: A color that is a blend of blue and purple, leaning more toward the blue end. A compound of {青|あお} (blue) and {紫|むらさき} (purple).

examples.japanese: {空|そら}が{青紫|あおむらさき}に{染|そ}まった。
{青紫|あおむらさき}の{紫陽花|あじさい}が{咲|さ}いている。
{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れの{空|そら}が{青紫|あおむらさき}から{濃紺|のうこん}に{変|か}わっていく{様子|ようす}が{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: It was beautiful watching the evening sky change from blue-purple to dark navy.

notes:
A compound color name combining {青|あお} (blue) and {紫|むらさき} (purple). This is a common pattern in Japanese for naming intermediate colors. The color sits between blue and purple on the spectrum.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青紫|あおむらさき}の{花|はな}: blue-purple flowers
- {青紫|あおむらさき}に{染|そ}まる: to be dyed blue-purple
- {青紫|あおむらさき}{色|いろ}: blue-purple color

RELATED WORDS:
- {紫|むらさき}: purple — one of the component colors
- {青|あお}: blue — the other component color
- {赤紫|あかむらさき}: red-purple; magenta — the opposite blend, leaning toward red
- {藍|あい}: indigo — a deep blue-violet dye and color with historical significance in Japan
